background_story: Oscar was a quiet, unassuming janitor who took pride in his work. For 20 years, he kept the local library spotless, often arriving before dawn to ensure the floors were immaculate. His trusty sidekick was a worn, reliable dustpan that had been with him since his first day on the job. Oscar's attention to detail and dedication to his craft earned him the respect and admiration of the library staff. Despite the mundane nature of his work, Oscar found joy in the simple act of sweeping and dusting, taking comfort in the knowledge that his efforts created a welcoming space for readers of all ages. His dustpan became a symbol of his commitment to his work, and he was often referred to as the 'keeper of the library's floors'.
